addressedAgentUnavailable: This AI teammate has been deactivated or removed, so the message didn't reach it. Send it to another teammate
agentCredentialTtlRange: The validity period must be between 1 and {max} days
agentDeliveryFailed: The message couldn't be delivered to the AI teammate. Send it again shortly
agentEditingTaken: {handle} is editing this teammate. Try again once they're done
agentHandleFormat: An AI teammate's username can only contain lowercase letters, digits and .-_, and must start with a letter or digit
agentHandleReserved: {handle} is the placeholder for an unidentified caller and can't be used as an AI teammate's username
agentHandleTaken: This project already has an AI teammate with the username {handle}
agentNameTooLong: The name can be at most 64 characters
agentSkillsStale: Someone else just changed this teammate, so your change wasn't saved. Refresh and try again
apiBaseMustBeHttps: api_base must be an address starting with https:// (except the metering proxy's ChatGPT entry http://metering-proxy:8445/chatgpt/<account>)
apiBaseNeedsHttps: The upstream API address must start with https://, except the metering proxy's ChatGPT entry http://metering-proxy:8445/chatgpt/<account>
askToList: to must be a non-empty list of people's handles, or all for everyone in the channel
askToNotInChannel: These people are not in this channel or cannot see it: {handles}. to takes handles of people in the channel, or all
assistantActReturned:
Not done. The reason, written to the person ("you" is the person): {reason}
Act on that reason: if it strays from what the person said, change it to what they said and try again; if the person has to decide or add something (whether to, which option, what to answer), ask them in your reply and act once they have said; if only their yes is missing, call again with confirm=true and they decide on a card in the panel. Do not reword it to get past the check.
assistantBusy: Cheese is busy right now. Try again later.
assistantCannotAnswerHere: The person answers this one on their inbox page
assistantCardLeftForLater: Nobody is there to confirm right now. The action was left for the person to confirm and was not done. Go on with the rest, or finish.
assistantCardStillWaiting: The person has not decided yet; the card stays in the panel. Tell them it waits there for them, and do not say it was done.
assistantChangeAlreadyUndone: This change has already been undone
assistantChangeMoved: This text has changed since, so the change can't be undone
assistantChangeNoSuchPart: This change doesn't include that item
assistantFailed: Cheese can't answer right now. Try again later.
assistantInviteThenAdmin: Invite someone outside the project as a member first; they can be made an admin once they join
assistantMemoryNotInRuns: A routine's run does not save memories: the person is not there, and what it read is other people's words and the platform's records.
assistantMemoryOff: The person has turned memory off in their settings; nothing is saved or changed.
assistantNoLongerWaiting: "{ref}" no longer waits on you: it was answered, or taken back.
assistantNoReviewCard: This task has no review card yet
assistantNotOpen: Cheese isn't available yet. Try again later.
assistantNotifyMeLimit: You can send the person at most {max} notifications an hour. Put what you have to say into one.
assistantPanelIsThePersons: This is where a person manages their Cheese; Cheese cannot act here for them
assistantProposalBadState: A draft can only be marked as sent or set aside
assistantProposalSettled: This draft has already been handled
assistantRefUnknown: "{ref}" is not a reference. A project's things are its short name and a path, such as ml-course/channels/3, ml-course/tasks/12, ml-course/tasks/12/review or ml-course/docs/5; the project itself is its short name.
assistantRepeating: Cheese started repeating the same passage over and over, so it was stopped. Try asking another way.
assistantSettingUnknown: No such setting; the ones that can be changed are {keys}
assistantStillAnswering: The last question is still being answered. Ask again when it's done.
assistantNotAnswering: Cheese is not answering now; ask your question instead
assistantWhoAmbiguous: More than one person is called "{who}": {handles}. Ask which one, and try again with the handle
assistantWhoUnknown: No one is called "{who}", by handle or by name. Ask for their handle
chatPublicationIdReused: This request_id was already used for another message
configModelReadOnly: The model {name} is declared in deploy/gateway/config.yaml, and the gateway won't {verb} it at runtime. To change it, edit deploy/gateway/config.yaml and release the gateway.
deactivateLastTeammate: Create another teammate before deactivating this one
deviceLinkLastFrame: its connector is online, and its last frame was {seconds} seconds ago
deviceLinkSilent: its connector is online but has never sent a frame
deviceNoAnswer: No answer from {who} for {seconds} seconds while {step}; {link}
deviceStepRefreshSession: syncing the AI teammate's work record
docAgentBoxFailed: {agent} can't answer right now. Try again later
environmentInvalid: That environment is not valid: it is either a sandbox of some spec or one computer someone enrolled
gatewayAdminNotConfigured: The model gateway's admin key isn't configured
gatewayLastOfferedModel: {name} is the last offered model: pausing, deleting or unlisting it would leave no model to choose when setting up an AI teammate. Offer another model first, then change this one
gatewayMissingList: The gateway's {path} response has no {field} list
gatewayModelExists: The model {name} already exists: to give it another upstream, add a source to it
gatewayModelHasRoles: The platform model roles {roles} still run on {name}: point them at another model under Platform model roles before pausing or deleting it
gatewayModelTimeout: The model didn't finish answering within {seconds} seconds
gatewayNoModelId: The gateway didn't return the new model's model_id
gatewayNotJson: The gateway answered with something other than JSON
gatewayUsageMissingResults: The gateway's usage response has no results list
handoffHistoryMigrationFailed: The AI teammate's work record couldn't be moved from the previous computer, so it didn't start this time. Messages in the channel are all kept; send again shortly
handoffSessionFileEndedEarly: The work record on the previous computer ended before the copy finished, so it didn't start this time. Send again shortly
handoffSessionFilesIncomplete: The previous computer is missing the AI teammate's full work record, so it hasn't moved to the cloud environment
handoffSessionNotExited: The AI teammate hasn't stopped on the previous computer yet, so it hasn't moved to the cloud environment. Send again shortly
handoffSessionStillChanging: The work record on the previous computer is still changing, so it hasn't moved to the cloud environment. Send again shortly
launcherNotWritten: Couldn't write the launch script to the device: {detail}
modelConnectionKindNotHeld: Your account can keep an Anthropic API key or a custom model service; sign in to a Claude subscription on a device
modelConnectionRefused: Not saved: the service failed the check ({reason})
modelGatewayUnreachable: Can't reach the model gateway. Try again shortly
modelLoginAuthorizationInvalid: This model login command is invalid or expired. Get a new command from the team Models page
modelLoginAuthorizationUsed: This model login command was already used. Get a new command from the team Models page
modelLoginConnectionUnknown: This computer has no registered model connection
modelNameInvalid: A model name is 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens
modelNeedsOverseasApproval: "{label}" has to be enabled for this team by a platform administrator first.
modelNotInPlan: The current plan does not include the model "{label}".
modelServiceIncomplete: A custom model service needs its address and model name
modelServiceNeedsHttps: The model service address must start with https://
modelUnavailable: This project can't use this model. Choose an available model
noModelToOffer: (this project has no models to choose from right now)
offeredNeedsPrices: A model needs both an input and an output price to be offered: an unpriced model silently disables the project's max_budget brake
ownAgentAddPersonOnly: Only members can add their own Claude Code to a project
ownAgentConnectionNotFound: Model connection not found: it isn't yours, or it was removed or logged out
ownAgentHasNoOwner: This agent has no personal owner to ask privately.
ownAgentNotFound: No member's own Claude Code by that name in this project
ownerMachineOffline: Can't start: the computer holding this model connection is offline
projectCredentialManagerOnly: Only someone who can change the project's settings can manage its credentials
projectNoGatewayKey: The project “{name}” has no gateway key yet, so its budget can't be set
roleNeedsOfferedModel: This role can only point at an offered model: {name} is not offered (paused, unlisted or unpriced)
roleNeedsServedModel: This role can only point at a served, priced model: {name} is paused or unpriced
roleNotFound: There is no platform model role called {role}
roomArchivedUnarchiveFirst: This channel is archived. Unarchive it to continue
roomBusyFinishBeforeEnvironment: The channel is working. Finish the current work before applying the environment configuration
roomBusyRetryLater: The channel is working. Try again later
sandboxAppArmor: This computer's AppArmor lets a program create a user namespace only when a profile names it. Run this once in a terminal on this computer: sudo ~/.local/bin/cheesehost sandbox allow
sandboxNoSeatbelt: This Mac has no /usr/bin/sandbox-exec, so it can't make an isolated environment. You can give the channel full access to this computer.
sandboxNoUserNamespaces: This computer doesn't let bubblewrap create a user namespace ({detail}).
sandboxNoneOnSystem: This computer's system ({system}) has no isolated environment. You can give the channel full access to this computer.
sandboxNoneOnWindows: Windows computers have no isolated environment. Install WSL, enroll it as a computer and choose it in the channel, or give the channel full access to this computer.
sandboxNotPlaced: cheesehost hasn't placed bubblewrap on this computer yet. Restart cheesehost; it places bubblewrap as it starts. Then come back to this page.
sandboxUserNamespacesOff: This computer has user namespaces turned off. Run sudo sysctl -w user.max_user_namespaces=15000 in a terminal, and put the same line in a file under /etc/sysctl.d/ to keep it after a reboot.
sandboxUsernsCloneOff: This computer has unprivileged user namespaces turned off. Run sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=1 in a terminal, and put the same line in a file under /etc/sysctl.d/ to keep it after a reboot.
screenAgentIdentityMissing: Couldn't find the AI teammate meant to work this time, so it didn't start. It may have been removed from the project; try another teammate
screenBillingCaEmpty: The metering proxy's CA is empty (SUBSCRIPTION_CA_BACKEND_PATH={path})
screenBillingCaPathUnset: SUBSCRIPTION_CA_BACKEND_PATH isn't set. A device screen needs the backend to read the metering proxy's CA (the deployment mounts the proxy's mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem read-only into the backend and points this at it)
screenBillingCaUnreadable: Couldn't read the metering proxy's CA (SUBSCRIPTION_CA_BACKEND_PATH={path}): {error}
screenCentralMachineOffline: The cloud environment that runs the AI teammate isn't connected right now, so it didn't start this time. Send again shortly
screenRoomReopenedOldEnvSkipped: The channel was just reopened, so this didn't start in the old environment. Send the message again to use the new one
screenSessionMachineNotReady: The computer that runs the AI teammate isn't set up or isn't connected, so it didn't start this time. Send again once it's connected
screenSetupStateUnreadable: Couldn't read the environment's setup state
sessionFilesNotSent: Couldn't sync the AI teammate's work record on the device: {detail}
sourceChatFoldsSystem: {name} has a source on the OpenAI-compatible Chat protocol, which loses system messages in the middle of a conversation, so mid-conversation system messages have to stay off
sourceChatNeedsConfigFlag: The config.yaml sources of {name} aren't marked supports_mid_conversation_system: false. A source on the OpenAI-compatible Chat protocol loses system messages in the middle of a conversation, so every source of the model needs the mark; edit deploy/gateway/config.yaml and release the gateway first
sourceConfigReadOnly: This source of {name} is declared in deploy/gateway/config.yaml, and the gateway won't change it at runtime. To change it, edit deploy/gateway/config.yaml and release the gateway.
sourceFreeNeedsZeroPrices: A free source needs both its input and output price written as 0
sourceHeaderDuplicate: The header {name} is given more than once
sourceHeaderNameInvalid: The header name {name} isn't valid: use letters, digits and !#$%&'*+.^_`|~-, at most 64 characters
sourceHeaderReserved: The header {name} can't be set per source: the gateway manages authentication and transport headers itself; put the upstream API key in the API key field
sourceHeaderValueInvalid: The value of header {name} isn't valid: no line breaks or other control characters, at most {max} characters
sourceHeadersTooMany: A source can set at most {max} headers
sourceModelHasSeveralSources: {name} has several sources; change the upstream address, API key and prices on the source itself
sourceNeedsPrices: Every source needs both an input and an output price; one may be 0 (such as a transcription model's output), and both at 0 is a free source, which must say so: the platform bills all of a model's usage by its prices
sourcePriceCleared: A price can be changed, not cleared: this edit clears {prices}
sourceSpendCapInConfig: {name} has a source on {upstream} in deploy/gateway/config.yaml whose spend cap differs from this one. A cap counts everything that upstream has been charged, so every source on it needs the same cap; move that row out of config.yaml, or change the cap there and release the gateway
sourceWouldBePrimary: Priority {order} would put this source ahead of every source {name} is serving from, taking their traffic; choose to make it the primary source explicitly, or give it a larger priority than the existing ones
sourceZeroPriceNeedsFree: An input or output price of 0 is only allowed on a source marked free: an unmarked zero price silently disables the project's max_budget brake
subagentModelNotAllowed: The model {model} the subagent asked for isn't among the models this project can use. Available: {offer}
subagentModelNotInCatalog: The model {model} the subagent asked for isn't in this project's model catalog. Available: {offer}
subscriptionModelNotInDocs: The selected subscription model can't be used in documents yet
taskClosedNoTurn: This task has ended and takes no more messages
teamConnectionModelRefused: This team connection does not allow the selected model
teammateHandleNotFound: This project has no teammate with the handle {handle}
teammateInactiveNoDefault: This teammate is deactivated and can't be made the default
teammateNotSeatedHere: This AI teammate isn't in this channel, so it can't work here. Add it to the channel, or ask another teammate
turnForceStopped: The platform stopped the AI teammate's work. Changes made so far are kept; send “continue” and it picks up where it left off
upstreamModelRequired: The upstream model ID can't be empty
assistantCitesTooMany: Cite at most {most} things in one question
